latin: Post passionem Christi potuerunt cerimonialia ueteris legis sine peccato obseruari.

mentions.context: Scotus’s account of this issue are not reflected in Pico’s thesis, but they might have played a part in his defending strategy during the public debate which was planned but never took place.
